title: calamintha nepeta subsp. glandulosa
intro: Calamintha nepeta subsp. glandulosa, commonly known as Nepeta glandulosa, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the Iberian Peninsula and North Africa. Nepeta glandulosa has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with reported benefits including relief from anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems, due to its adaptogenic and carminative properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
